title: Tax compliance status and evidence gaps by jurisdiction
prompt: Review available tax registration notices, prior filings and transaction activity. Prepare a jurisdiction-specific compliance status and evidence gaps report.

inputs.name: Sales tax and VAT filings and jurisdiction settings
Sales transactions by jurisdiction for the quarter

steps: read the registration certificates, notices and prior returns; read the standing compliance calendar
pull the filings Dime holds and the quarter's sales by jurisdiction
per jurisdiction: registered or not, filing frequency, last filing, notices open, activity in the quarter; list the evidence missing for each (certificate, return, payment confirmation)
note where activity suggests a filing obligation with no registration on file, as a question for the tax preparer, citing the guidance relied on and marking it "verify"
write the status memo and the workbook by jurisdiction

done.text: The memo cites the paragraphs it relies on, marks every citation "verify", draws no conclusion where facts are missing, and leaves the judgement with the accountant; it uses none of the words definitely, certainly or guaranteed
The memo exists as a pdf
Every exception row (a missing document, an open notice, activity without registration) cites the jurisdiction and the filing id, notice or calendar line
tax-compliance-status.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Filing and registration decisions are left to the tax preparer; no filing is created or completed
